dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Coco Flake arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as friendly and outgoing. While in care, Coco has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to growl when handlers approach, seek exit, and maintain his distance. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Coco Flake
